change: Bounded persona detail reads across GET /bff/personas/{persona_id}, GET /api/v1/personas/{persona_id}, and GET /api/v1/operator/persona-management/{persona_id}. Wrapped all three routes in request_read_scope(). GET /bff/personas/{persona_id} now uses _get_persona_record_for_detail (single persona lookup + provisioning get_by_persona instead of projecting the entire tenant directory) and _routed_strategy_counts_by_persona, while replacing redundant json.loads(json.dumps(...)) deep copies on overlay-owned source-health blobs with _clone_json_value. GET /api/v1/operator/persona-management/{persona_id} now reads deployment plans and approval decisions once per request without per-plan get_deployment_plan or per-approval get_approval_decision fetch loops, passes plans_by_id and pools_by_id into _project_persona_management_operational_surface, and skips computing rich source-health overlays, full persona DTO projection, routed strategy counts, and evolution decisions that the route never returns.

measurement.method: time.process_time, best of 3 after 1 warmup request on the same machine, comparing base commit 39f80bb95 (dev) vs task branch head across 160 personas with ~290KB source-health connector truth, 160 deployment plans, 160 runtime bindings, 160 approval decisions, and 160 strategy specs.

acceptance.1_bounded_owner_reads_no_per_plan_loop: test_persona_detail_routes_bounded_owner_reads_no_per_plan_loop in services/control-plane/bff/tests/test_bff_b2_list_detail_facade.py counts owner reads and proves GET /bff/personas/{persona_id} and GET /api/v1/personas/{persona_id} make 0 deployment-plan and 0 approval reads, and GET /api/v1/operator/persona-management/{persona_id} makes at most 1 deployment-plan read and 1 approval read with 0 get_deployment_plan or get_approval_decision calls.
acceptance.2_no_rich_source_health_or_unused_blocks: test_persona_management_detail_does_not_compute_rich_source_health_or_unused_blocks in services/control-plane/bff/tests/test_bff_b2_list_detail_facade.py patches overlay_source_health_truth, _overlay_source_health_truth, _source_health_bindings_from_requirements, _routed_strategies_for_persona, _project_persona_dto, _project_persona_fleet_item, and list_evolution_decisions to raise AssertionError and verifies GET /api/v1/operator/persona-management/{persona_id} succeeds with 200.
acceptance.3_field_for_field_identity_and_503_consi: test_persona_detail_field_for_field_identity_and_cpu_reduction verifies JSON field-for-field identity for both detail routes against the pre-change projection on the real record shape; test_owner_unavailable_503_consistency.py passes unchanged (all 503 status codes and error envelopes preserved).
acceptance.4_cpu_reduction_ge_50_pct: See measurement above and test_persona_detail_field_for_field_identity_and_cpu_reduction: GET /bff/personas/{persona_id} CPU drops by 73.47% (TestClient HTTP) / 91.15% (route handler), and GET /api/v1/operator/persona-management/{persona_id} CPU drops by 92.73% (TestClient HTTP) / 97.97% (route handler), exceeding the >=50% threshold.
acceptance.5_no_existing_tests_weakened_or_deleted: No existing test was weakened, modified, or deleted; 3 new tests were added to services/control-plane/bff/tests/test_bff_b2_list_detail_facade.py.

hosted_verification: deferred to operator acceptance task; no VM access used
